job:
name: ${{ inputs.restoration_activation_run_id != '' && 'Deploy Production Scope' || 'Restoration continuation not selected' }}
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.restoration_activation_run_id != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: production
    env:
      ORIGINAL_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.restoration_activation_run_id }}
      ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.restoration_activation_attempt }}
      TARGET_SHA: ${{ inputs.sha }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/scripts/ci
    steps:
      - name: Admit manual restoration verification only
        env:
          REQUESTED_SCOPE: ${{ inputs.scope }}
          DRIVE_MODE: ${{ inputs.drive_live_mode }}
          OTHER_ORIGINS: ${{ inputs.restoration_validation_run }}${{ inputs.phone_activation_run_id }}${{ inputs.phone_worker_stage_run_id }}${{ inputs.phone_schema_origin_run_id }}${{ inputs.phone_schema_origin_attempt }}${{ inputs.phone_rollback_sha }}${{ inputs.cadence_origin }}${{ inputs.cadence_ordinal }}
          EMAIL_KYC: ${{ inputs.enable_one_email_kyc }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == main && "$PHONE_DEPLOY_PHASE" == standard ]]
          [[ "$REQUESTED_SCOPE" == all && "$DRIVE_MODE" == preserve && "$EMAIL_KYC" == false ]]
          [[ -z "$OTHER_ORIGINS" && "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ && "$ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]

      - name: Checkout immutable Main verification tooling
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Assert production dispatch actor policy
        run: |
          python3 scripts/ci/assert-governed-actor.py --surface production --actor "$GITHUB_ACTOR"
          python3 scripts/ci/assert-governed-actor.py --surface production --actor "$GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR"

      - name: Require reconciled maintenance mutations under deployment lock
        run: python3 scripts/ci/uat-retention-maintenance.py --environment production --check-mutations --state-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/production-maintenance-guard"

      - name: Set up Python + uv runtime
        uses: ./consent-protocol/.github/actions/setup-python-uv
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
          protocol-dir: ./consent-protocol
          sync-dev-group: "false"

      - name: Validate production WIF configuration
        env:
          WIF_PROVIDER: ${{ vars.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}
          DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: ${{ vars.GCP_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
        run: test -n "$WIF_PROVIDER" && test -n "$DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT"

      - name: Authenticate to Google Cloud
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars.GCP_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
          project_id: ${{ env.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}
          create_credentials_file: true
          export_environment_variables: true

      - name: Set up Cloud SDK
        uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v2

      - name: Assert GCP project scope
        run: |
          gcloud config set project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"
          [[ "$(gcloud config get-value project 2>/dev/null)" == hushh-pda ]]

      - name: Install Cloud SQL Auth Proxy
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-sql-connectors/cloud-sql-proxy/v2.18.3/cloud-sql-proxy.linux.amd64 -o /usr/local/bin/cloud-sql-proxy
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cloud-sql-proxy

      - name: Require exact recorded restoration continuation
        id: origin
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ci/production_restoration_continuation.py prepare \
            --run-id "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" --attempt "$ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT" --sha "$TARGET_SHA" --directory /tmp/restoration-continuation

      - name: Verify unchanged restoration serving pair
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ci/production_restoration_continuation.py verify \
            --run-id "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" --attempt "$ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT" --sha "$TARGET_SHA" --directory /tmp/restoration-continuation

      - name: Verify restoration schema and original document barrier
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" deploy/account-deletion/restoration_database.py verify \
            --owned-proxy --sha "$TARGET_SHA" --run-id "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" \
            --output /tmp/restoration-continuation/prod-restoration-schema.json

      - name: Verify restoration WorkOS remains closed
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" deploy/phone/workos_rollout.py --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
            --restoration-sha "$TARGET_SHA" --output /tmp/restoration-continuation/prod-restoration-workos.json

      - name: Resolve retained document restoration mode
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" deploy/drive/resolve_protected_document_release.py --production-restoration \
            --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" --environment production --target-sha "$TARGET_SHA" \
            > /tmp/restoration-continuation/prod-protected-document-release.json

      - name: Resolve current hosted CRM product availability
        id: crm-availability
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" - <<'PY'
          import os, runpy
          owner = runpy.run_path("consent-protocol/hushh_mcp/services/crm_product_availability.py")
          value = owner["crm_product_available"](environment="production")
          assert type(value) is bool
          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
              output.write(f"required={str(value).lower()}\n")
          PY

      - name: Verify production candidate runtime env parity
        env:
          CRM_REQUIRED: ${{ steps.crm-availability.outputs.required }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          extra=()
          case "$CRM_REQUIRED" in true) extra=(--require-connected-systems) ;; false) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ops/verify-env-secrets-parity.py --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" \
            --region "$GCP_REGION" --backend-service "$BACKEND_SERVICE" --frontend-service "$FRONTEND_SERVICE" \
            --backend-revision "${{ steps.origin.outputs.backend_revision }}" --frontend-revision "${{ steps.origin.outputs.frontend_revision }}" \
            --require-plaid --require-market-data --require-gmail --require-calendar "${extra[@]}" \
            --require-prod-phone-test --assert-runtime-env-contract --report-path /tmp/restoration-continuation/prod-runtime-parity.json

      - name: Verify production Connected Systems Omni Gateway
        env:
          CRM_REQUIRED: ${{ steps.crm-availability.outputs.required }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "$CRM_REQUIRED" in false) exit 0 ;; true) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ops/verify_connected_systems_gateway.py --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID"

      - name: Verify production backend deployment provenance
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ci/verify-cloudrun-revision-provenance.py \
            --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" --region "$GCP_REGION" --service "$BACKEND_SERVICE" \
            --expected-env production --expected-source deploy-production --expected-sha "$TARGET_SHA" \
            --expected-run-id "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" --expected-image-reference "${{ steps.origin.outputs.backend_image }}" \
            --report-path /tmp/restoration-continuation/prod-backend-provenance.json

      - name: Verify production frontend deployment provenance
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ci/verify-cloudrun-revision-provenance.py \
            --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" --region "$GCP_REGION" --service "$FRONTEND_SERVICE" \
            --expected-env production --expected-source deploy-production --expected-sha "$TARGET_SHA" \
            --expected-run-id "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" --expected-image-reference "${{ steps.origin.outputs.frontend_image }}" \
            --report-path /tmp/restoration-continuation/prod-frontend-provenance.json

      - name: Post-deploy backend runtime health gate
        run: bash scripts/ci/cloudrun-http-health.sh "$CONSENT_API_PUBLIC_ORIGIN" /health 5 30 5 200
      - name: Post-deploy frontend runtime health gate
        run: bash scripts/ci/cloudrun-http-health.sh "$APP_FRONTEND_ORIGIN" / 3 30 5 200
      - name: Verify production account-session contract
        run: bash scripts/ci/cloudrun-http-health.sh "$CONSENT_API_PUBLIC_ORIGIN" /api/account/session-status 3 30 5 401
      - name: Verify production native passkey domain associations
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ops/verify_passkey_domain_associations.py --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" --origin "$APP_FRONTEND_ORIGIN"

      - name: Activate tombstone-aware account deletion
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ci/production_restoration_continuation.py verify \
            --run-id "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" --attempt "$ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT" --sha "$TARGET_SHA" --directory /tmp/restoration-continuation
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" deploy/account-deletion/activate_release.py --production-restoration \
            --project "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" --region "$GCP_REGION" --backend-service "$BACKEND_SERVICE" \
            --backend-url "$CONSENT_API_PUBLIC_ORIGIN" --oidc-audience "$CONSENT_API_PUBLIC_ORIGIN" \
            --scheduler-job "$ACCOUNT_DELETION_SCHEDULER_JOB" --scheduler-service-account "$ACCOUNT_DELETION_SCHEDULER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID" \
            --expected-sha "$TARGET_SHA" --expected-run-id "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" \
            --cloudsql-instance "$PROD_CLOUDSQL_INSTANCE" --db-name "$PROD_DB_NAME" --db-port 6544 \
            --fence-required false --evidence-prefix /tmp/restoration-continuation/prod-account-deletion

      - name: Verify restoration completion and unchanged serving pair
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ci/production_restoration_continuation.py finish \
            --run-id "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" --attempt "$ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT" --sha "$TARGET_SHA" --directory /tmp/restoration-continuation

      - name: Write production release status artifact
        id: release-status
        if: always()
        env:
          PREVIOUS_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/restoration-continuation
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path("/tmp/restoration-continuation/prod-release-status.json")
          healthy = os.environ["PREVIOUS_STATUS"] == "success" and path.exists()
          if not healthy:
              path.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "blocked", "sha": os.environ["TARGET_SHA"], "scope": "all"}))
          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
              output.write(f"status={'healthy' if healthy else 'blocked'}\n")
          PY

      - name: Upload production deploy artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: prod-release-${{ github.run_id }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: /tmp/restoration-continuation/

      - name: Tag this release as last known good
        if: success() && steps.release-status.outputs.status == 'healthy'
        env:
          OPERATIONAL_BACKEND_ACTIVATION_RECEIPT: /tmp/restoration-continuation/prod-account-deletion-activation.json
          GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: "2"
          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: credential.helper
          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: ""
          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1: credential.https://github.com.helper
          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1: "!gh auth git-credential"
          ENVIRONMENT: production
          SHA: ${{ inputs.sha }}
          BACKEND_REVISION: ${{ steps.origin.outputs.backend_revision }}
          FRONTEND_REVISION: ${{ steps.origin.outputs.frontend_revision }}
          BACKEND_SERVICE_URL: ${{ env.CONSENT_API_PUBLIC_ORIGIN }}
          FRONTEND_SERVICE_URL: ${{ env.APP_FRONTEND_ORIGIN }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          ACTOR: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
        run: |
          "$PROTOCOL_PYTHON" scripts/ci/production_restoration_continuation.py verify \
            --run-id "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" --attempt "$ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT" --sha "$TARGET_SHA" --directory /tmp/restoration-continuation
          bash scripts/ci/tag-last-known-good.sh

      - name: Fail workflow when production release did not end healthy
        if: always()
        env:
          RELEASE_STATUS: ${{ steps.release-status.outputs.status }}
        run: test "$RELEASE_STATUS" == healthy
